attributes.board_name: Junta Examinadora de Terapia Física de Puerto Rico (Departamento de Salud)

rules.accepted_credit_types: Board-approved activities from providers designated by the Secretary of Health; Board-approved activities of providers for other health professions; activities outside Puerto Rico or correspondence/TV courses sponsored by APTA, the Latin American or World Confederation for Physical Therapy and their chapters (submit program, description, contact hours, speaker, proof); publications (book 3.0 UEC sole author, 2.0 co-author, article 1.0); lecturer/panelist 1.5 h per hour (max 15 h per triennium); published research (1.0-2.0 UEC). At least 10 contact hours in the clinical area per triennium; generic courses max 10 h. Courses under 3 hours and repeated content are not credited.
rules.new_licensee_rule: Exempt for one year after the regular license is issued; the proportional part of the triennium requirement applies.
rules.carryover: Up to 10 contact hours in physical therapy-related courses may be carried to the next triennium.
rules.audit_note: Evidence of CE (original or verified copies of provider certificates) is submitted with the registry/recertification application by the 30th of the birth month.
rules.legal_basis: Reglamento 4550 (Educación Continua y Registro, Junta de Terapia Física, 1991); Ley Núm. 11 de 23 de junio de 1976, Art. 9
rules.notes: Recertification every three years in the licensee's birth month. Reglamento 4550 states the requirement as 30 contact hours = 3.0 U.E.C. (1 U.E.C. = 10 contact hours; 1 contact hour = 50-60 minutes). Retired licensees need half the hours. The Board's page still lists Reglamento 4550 (1991) as the CE rule.

rules.accepted_credit_types: Same activities as PT: at least 10 contact hours clinical per triennium, generic courses max 10 h, courses under 3 hours not credited.
rules.new_licensee_rule: Exempt for one year after the regular license is issued; proportional part of the triennium requirement applies.
rules.carryover: Up to 10 contact hours in physical therapy-related courses may be carried to the next triennium.
rules.audit_note: CE evidence is submitted with the recertification application by the 30th of the birth month.
rules.legal_basis: Reglamento 4550 (Educación Continua y Registro, Junta de Terapia Física, 1991); Ley Núm. 11 de 23 de junio de 1976, Art. 9
rules.notes: Recertification every three years in the birth month; 21 contact hours = 2.1 U.E.C. (1 U.E.C. = 10 contact hours). Retired licensees need half.
